model.spec: weighted ridge off/def ratings (the frozen team_points ridge): alpha 2.0, prior-season decay 0.2, history 3 seasons, FCS pooled into one entity, conference offsets on (alpha 0.25)

league.rule: ranks are withheld while the current-season FBS-vs-FBS schedule graph is disconnected AND the median FBS team has fewer than 4 games; teams outside the main component stay withheld; provisional while the graph is not yet one component or the team has fewer than 3 games

notes: Shadow output: the production script-engine ranks are unchanged; each team carries the engine's own current rank in `script_engine` for comparison.
`rank` is null (rank_status SUPPRESSED) while the FBS schedule graph is disconnected; `rank_lo`/`rank_hi` (80% band) are always published.
Validation: results/defense_ratings_validation.json (next-game points allowed, validation + holdout).
